usage: 紅燒肉 is used as a noun referring to a specific dish made from pork belly cooked in a sweet and savory red sauce.
You can use 紅燒肉 to talk about what you want to order in a restaurant or describe dishes at home.
紅燒肉 often appears in compound phrases when specifying types of cuisine or menu items.
When you want to emphasize the cooking style or ingredients, 紅燒肉 can be combined with adjectives or other descriptive words.
While 紅燒肉 is specific to pork belly, it is commonly understood without extra context in restaurants or food discussions.
